name: KSR Campaign
query:
SELECT
    si.medical_department AS "Department",
    si.posting_date AS "Date",
    si.patient AS "Patient ID",
    si.patient_name AS "Patient Name",
    si.contact_mobile AS "Mobile",
        1 AS "Qty:Int:60"
FROM
    `tabSales Invoice` si
    
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name

LEFT JOIN
    `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = si.customer,
    (SELECT @row_number:=0) AS t
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND c.customer_group = 'KSR Campaign'
    AND si.status = 'Paid'
    AND sii.item_code = 'KSR OT Charge'
    AND si.medical_department IN ('ENT', 'Urology', 'General Surgery')
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    si.posting_date ASC;
